title: Three Nights and One Short Lens
subtitle: 生命科学 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 生命科学（科学与技术·生物与生命科学）
meta: 主题语境：生命科学（科学与技术·生物与生命科学）　|　核心词汇：reaction　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 reaction 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1957 the observer ① watched the reaction that no assistant in the observatory would have measured, and he said the watching was the whole of the night. The ② reaction, meaning the response itself and not the lens, ran three nights and stayed unmeasured in the book; a reaction, he said, is the only thing in an observatory that is judged by how long it is left unmeasured.

Every ③ reaction in that observatory had the same short lens beside it, and the ④ reaction at the far dome, meaning the reading they kept for the children to note and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A reaction, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to measure; the observer said the measuring is the part that fills three nights.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the reaction was the whole of the matter, meaning the feeling and not the response. The ⑥ reaction, meaning the feeling and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody measures; reaction, he said, is either something you watch or the only word that means both a response and a feeling. He said the feeling is the part they remember.

By 1962 the ⑦ reaction had become a line in a log, and the log had become an argument about the short lens. The ⑧ reaction of the whole thing, the observer wrote in November, was one observatory and three nights of measuring; reaction, he said, is either the reading at the far dome or the reason you learned to measure. He said the measuring was never mentioned.

The ⑨ reaction I remember is the response measured in the log, which closed in 1964 and is still measured as the quietest in the observatory. A ⑩ reaction, my mother said in 1966, is the only response that improves by being measured; every reaction, she said, is a feeling that has agreed to look like a response. She said the feeling was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 反应（指观测站里每一种旁边的那一种）
B. n. 反应（指那种反应本身，与小小的镜片相对）
C. 固定搭配：watch the reaction 观察这一种反应
D. n. 反应（指留给孩子们记的那一组）
E. n. 反应之事（抽象总称，指一处观测站的反应之事）
F. n. 反应（指观测记录里写到、被测量的那一种）
G. n. 反应、情绪（指一件事里人人都望却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 情绪（抽象总称，指人人都望却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: watched the reaction that no assistant in the observatory would have measured
The reaction, meaning the response itself and not the lens
the reaction at the far dome
the reaction was the whole of the matter
the reaction had become a line in a log
The reaction of the whole thing
A reaction, my mother said in 1966

answers.why: watch the reaction 意为“观察这一种反应”，1957 年那位观测员把观测站里没有一位助手肯测量的一种反应做了一遍。
reaction 意为“反应”，指那种反应本身而不是小小的镜片，它经过了三个夜晚而在簿子上没有被测量。
reaction 意为“反应”，指观测站里每一种旁边的那一种，每一种旁边都有同一片小小的镜片。
reaction 意为“反应”，指最远那座圆顶的留给孩子们记的那一组，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
reaction 意为“反应、情绪”，指一件事里人人都望却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这种情绪就是那件事的全部。
reaction 意为“情绪”，指人人都望却无人提起的那样东西而不是那种反应，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
reaction 意为“反应”，指观测记录里写到、被测量的那一种，到 1962 年这一种成了观测记录里的一行。
reaction 意为“反应之事”，观测员十一月写道，整件事的反应之事是一处观测站和三个夜晚的测量。
reaction 意为“反应”，我记得的是观测记录里测量过的那一种，1964 年记下了，至今仍被说成观测站里最安静的一种。
reaction 为抽象总称，母亲 1966 年说，反应是唯一会因为被好好测量而变得更好的反应。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1957 年那位观测员观察了观测站里没有一位助手肯测量的一种反应，他说这一遍才是那个夜晚的全部。（watch the reaction）
那种反应，指的是那种反应本身而不是小小的镜片，经过了三个夜晚而在簿子上没有被测量。（reaction）
那处观测站里每一种反应旁边都有同一片小小的镜片。（reaction）
最远那座圆顶那种反应，指的是他们留给孩子们记的那一组，是唯一有人谢过两次的。（reaction）
叔叔说这种情绪就是那件事的全部，指的是那样东西而不是那种反应。（reaction）
1966 年母亲说，反应是唯一会因为被好好测量而变得更好的反应。（reaction）
